warm_bf16.description: 4n^3 (Q^T C Q) + 2n^3 (Q A) + 2 x [2n^3 (Y^T Y) + 2n^3 (Y E)]; elementwise ignored

eigh.description: conventional 9n^3 for symmetric eigensolver with vectors (Golub & Van Loan); actual syevd count varies

cholqr.description: 2n^3 (C Q) + 2n^3 (Z^T Z, full bmm) + n^3/3 (chol) + n^3 (trsm)

cholqr3.description: 2n^3 (C Q) + 3 x [2n^3 (X^T X) + n^3/3 (chol) + n^3 (trsm)]; power iteration ignored

tflops_definition: flops_per_factor / (median_ms / batch); compiled and eager rows alike
cholqr3_definition:
, for X = Z[:, pi] (n x n, m = n):
  G = X^T X;  s = 11 (m n + n (n + 1)) u ||X||_2^2  with u = 2^-24 and ||X||_2^2
  estimated as the Rayleigh quotient of 20 power iterations on G;
  R1 = chol(G + s I);  X1 = X R1^-1;  then two unshifted CholeskyQR passes.
No other safeguard; failures (info > 0) and non-finite outputs are recorded.
